name: Japanese Economic Association 2027 Spring Meeting
submission_requirements: Only JEA members may present (non-members must first apply for membership); applications only via the member My Page; student members on the reduced fee may apply for poster presentations only; spring presenters must pay the meeting-year membership fee by end of April. Whether English-language papers are accepted is not stated on the pages checked.
membership_required: Yes: JEA membership required to present
expected_note: Host and dates announced; the JEA meetings page says no presentation applications are currently open. The 2026 spring application guide was posted in Nov 2025, but its deadline could not be read (PDF not accessible), so this date is a rough placeholder, not a shifted known deadline.
